nodes.description: Owner address state variable in Ownable; controls all privileged functions.
Payable destination address in Receiver that receives the contract balance.
Context helper returning msg.sender; used as identity source for ownership.
Ownable.transferOwnership, external and onlyOwner guarded; updates owner.
Ownable private setter that writes the _owner state variable.
Receiver.changeAddress, onlyOwner guarded; writes the payout address state variable.
Receiver.transfer, onlyOwner guarded; reads contract balance and sends it to addr.
Receiver receive/fallback payable functions accepting plain Ether.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership comparison.
Value transfer of the full contract balance to the stored payout address; external call executed after balance read.
Parameter of transferOwnership carrying the new owner address.
Parameter of changeAddress carrying the new payout address.
Local variable holding address(this).balance inside transfer().

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier compares _owner against msg.sender, so the untrusted caller controls whether the guard passes.
_msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller identity.
onlyOwner gates execution of transfer, restricting who can drain the balance.
The _owner state variable is read inside the onlyOwner check.
newaddr parameter is written into the payout address by changeAddress.
changeAddress updates the addr state variable.
The addr state variable is the destination of the value transfer.
transfer reads address(this).balance into the local variable.
The balance local variable determines the amount transferred.
transfer() branches on balance > 0 and then executes the value transfer.
addr.transfer executes recipient code (receive/fallback) which can re-enter the contract after the balance was read.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only a formal parameter of transferOwnership and has no independent semantics outside that function.
newaddr is only a formal parameter of changeAddress and exists solely to update the addr state variable.
balance is a transient local that only feeds the amount argument of the external value transfer.
